items.Sentence: Secondary treatment at HARRF is accomplished by mechanically cleaned bar screens and aerated grit removal (cyclonic grit chambers), chemically-enhanced primary treatment (CEPT), aeration basins equipped with membrane fine-bubble diffusers, and secondary clarifiers.
Tertiary treatment at HARRF consists of chemical coagulation and flocculation, DynaSand® monomedia continuous backwash upflow filtration, and disinfection using ultraviolet light and/or chlorination.
A portion of the tertiary-treated wastewater will supply the proposed MFRO Facility.
